protocol.study: Exploratory synthetic factor portfolio basin search
protocol.returns: Uniform(.01,.05) after drawing L with default_rng(seed)
protocol.initial: Exact independent unshifted local optimum; common to both methods
protocol.local_solver: Enumerate all six feasible local states; deterministic lexicographic ties
protocol.stopping: One full no-improvement sweep, finite-state cap 217; also compare six-sweep endpoints
protocol.selection: First seed where CAF reaches enumerated global optimum, BCD gap>=.001 and >=20% of initial-to-optimum gap, both settled by six sweeps; symmetric reverse example also retained.
protocol.interpretation: Purposefully selected mechanism examples. Full seed outcomes retained, not a general superiority claim. Sector blocks externally specified, not Newman partitions.
